description: This is a Java interface defining data access operations for Product entities in the sales management system. It includes methods for retrieving products based on locale, categories, store, tax class, SEO URL, and code, as well as listing products with criteria.

classes.name: ProductDao
classes.description: A data access object interface for Product entity, extending generic sales manager DAO and providing methods to retrieve products based on various filters.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its ID, specified language, and locale, to support locale-specific product details.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products for a merchant store and category IDs, filtered by language and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products associated with given category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products for a specific store, optionally filtered by criteria or categories.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a particular tax class.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Returns products filtered by category IDs and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its SEO URL, store, and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product using its product code and language.
